content.value: A municipality wants to install a low-cost communication cable network connecting (20) [CO4] following administrative hubs: A(City Hall); B(Health Center); C(Fire Station); D(Water Supply Office); E(Transport Control Unit).
The Cost (in millions of Taka) of laying cables between these hubs is given below:

content.value: The municipality authority wants a layout that (i) Connects all five hubs, (ii) Avoids cycles, and (iii) Minimizes total cabling cost. Now design your cable network following these guidelines.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
